name: Gor (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, red above and below and yellow at the hoist and fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Gor (a castle and a lion).
history: The municipality of Gor has its own arms and flag, although they have not been made official under the regional regulations, which does not prevent their widespread use; the flag is rectangular, quartered per saltire, the upper and lower triangles red and the lateral ones yellow, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: per saltire: red above and below, yellow at the hoist and fly
